Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
Reflexion：以言语强化学习为基础的语言智能体

Abstract
摘要

Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used to interact with external environments (e.g., games, compilers, APIs) as goal-driven agents. However, it remains challenging for these language agents to quickly and efficiently learn from trial-and-error as traditional reinforcement learning methods require extensive training samples and expensive model fine-tuning. We propose Reflexion, a novel framework to reinforce language agents not by updating weights, but instead through linguistic feedback. Concretely, Reflexion agents verbally reflect on task feedback signals, then maintain their own reflective text in an episodic memory buffer to induce better decision-making in subsequent trials. Reflexion is flexible enough to incorporate various types (scalar values or free-form language) and sources (external or internally simulated) of feedback signals, and obtains significant improvements over a baseline agent across diverse tasks (sequential decision-making, coding, language reasoning). For example, Reflexion achieves a 91% pass@1 accuracy on the HumanEval coding benchmark, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art GPT-4 that achieves 80%. We also conduct ablation and analysis studies using different feedback signals, feedback incorporation methods, and agent types, and provide insights into how they affect performance. We release all code, demos, and datasets at https://github.com/noahshinn024/reflexion.

大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作目标驱动的智能体，与外部环境（如游戏、编译器和API）交互。然而，让这些语言智能体迅速而高效地从试错中学习，仍然是一项挑战，因为传统强化学习方法需要大量训练样本和代价高昂的模型微调。我们提出Reflexion，一种通过语言反馈而非更新权重来强化语言智能体的新框架。具体而言，Reflexion智能体以语言反思任务反馈信号，随后将自身生成的反思文本保存在情景记忆缓冲区中，以促使后续尝试作出更好的决策。Reflexion十分灵活，能够纳入不同类型（标量或自由形式语言）和不同来源（外部或内部模拟）的反馈信号，并在多种任务（序列决策、编程、语言推理）中相较基线智能体取得显著提升。例如，Reflexion在HumanEval编程基准上的pass@1准确率达到91%，超过此前达到80%的最先进模型GPT-4。我们还使用不同的反馈信号、反馈纳入方式和智能体类型进行消融与分析研究，探讨它们如何影响表现。全部代码、演示和数据集发布于https://github.com/noahshinn024/reflexion。
1 Introduction
1 引言

Recent works such as ReAct [30], SayCan [1], Toolformer [22], HuggingGPT [23], generative agents [19], and WebGPT [17] have demonstrated the feasibility of autonomous decision-making agents that are built on top of a large language model (LLM) core. These methods use LLMs to generate text and actions that can be used in API calls and executed in an environment. Since they rely on massive models with an enormous number of parameters, such approaches have been so far limited to using in-context examples as a way of teaching the agents, since more traditional optimization schemes like reinforcement learning with gradient descent require substantial amounts of compute and time.

ReAct [30]、SayCan [1]、Toolformer [22]、HuggingGPT [23]、生成式智能体 [19]和WebGPT [17]等近期工作，已展示了以大语言模型（LLM）为核心构建自主决策智能体的可行性。这些方法使用LLM生成文本和“行动”，后者可以用于API调用并在环境中执行。由于依赖参数数量极其庞大的巨型模型，这些方法迄今主要只能通过上下文示例来教导智能体，因为使用梯度下降的强化学习等更传统的优化方案，需要大量算力和时间。

预印本。审稿中。

In this paper, we propose an alternative approach called Reflexion that uses verbal reinforcement to help agents learn from prior failings. Reflexion converts binary or scalar feedback from the environment into verbal feedback in the form of a textual summary, which is then added as additional context for the LLM agent in the next episode. This self-reflective feedback acts as a semantic' gradient signal by providing the agent with a concrete direction to improve upon, helping it learn from prior mistakes to perform better on the task. This is akin to how humans iteratively learn to accomplish complex tasks in a few-shot manner -- by reflecting on their previous failures in order to form an improved plan of attack for the next attempt. For example, in figure 1, a Reflexion agent learns to optimize its own behavior to solve decision-making, programming, and reasoning tasks through trial, error, and self-reflection.

本文提出一种名为Reflexion的替代方法，利用言语强化帮助智能体从以往的失败中学习。Reflexion将环境给出的二元或标量反馈转换为文本摘要形式的言语反馈，随后在下一个回合中将其作为额外上下文提供给LLM智能体。这种自我反思反馈为智能体指出具体的改进方向，起到“语义”梯度信号的作用，帮助它从以往错误中学习，从而更好地完成任务。这类似于人类以少样本的方式迭代学习复杂任务：通过反思先前的失败，为下一次尝试制定改进后的行动方案。例如，在图1中，Reflexion智能体通过尝试、出错和自我反思，学会优化自身行为，以解决决策、编程和推理任务。

Generating useful reflective feedback is challenging since it requires a good understanding of where the model made mistakes (i.e. the credit assignment problem [25]) as well as the ability to generate a summary containing actionable insights for improvement. We explore three ways for doing this -- simple binary environment feedback, pre-defined heuristics for common failure cases, and self-evaluation such as binary classification using LLMs (decision-making) or self-written unit tests (programming). In all implementations, the evaluation signal is amplified to natural language experience summaries which can be stored in long-term memory.
生成有用的反思反馈并不容易，因为这既需要充分理解模型在哪些地方犯了错（即信用分配问题 [25]），也需要能够生成包含可付诸行动的改进见解的摘要。我们探索了三种实现途径：简单的二元环境反馈、针对常见失败情形预先定义的启发式方法，以及自我评估，例如利用LLM进行二元分类（决策任务），或自行编写单元测试（编程任务）。在所有实现中，评估信号都被扩展为能够存入长期记忆的自然语言经验摘要。

Reflexion has several advantages compared to more traditional RL approaches like policy or value-based learning: 1) it is lightweight and doesn't require finetuning the LLM, 2) it allows for more nuanced forms of feedback (e.g. targeted changes in actions), compared to scalar or vector rewards that are challenging to perform accurate credit assignment with, 3) it allows for a more explicit and interpretable form of episodic memory over prior experiences, and 4) it provides more explicit hints for actions in future episodes. At the same time, it does have the disadvantages of relying on the power of the LLM's self-evaluation capabilities (or heuristics) and not having a formal guarantee for success. However, as LLM capabilities improve, we only expect this paradigm to get better over time.

相较于基于策略或价值学习等更传统的强化学习方法，Reflexion具有几项优势：1）它较为轻量，不需要微调LLM；2）相较于难以据之进行精确信用分配的标量或向量奖励，它能够提供更细致的反馈形式（例如有针对性地改变行动）；3）它能以更明确、可解释的情景记忆形式保存以往经验；4）它为未来回合中的行动提供更明确的提示。同时，它也存在不足：依赖LLM的自我评估能力（或启发式方法），而且没有成功的形式化保证。不过，随着LLM能力的增强，我们预期这一范式只会随时间进一步改善。

We perform experiments on (1) decision-making tasks to test sequential action choices over long trajectories, (2) reasoning tasks to test knowledge-intensive, single-step generation improvement, and (3) programming tasks to teach the agent to effectively use external tools such as compilers and interpreters. Across all three types of tasks, we observe Reflexion agents are better decision-makers, reasoners, and programmers. More concretely, Reflexion agents improve on decision-making AlfWorld [24] tasks over strong baseline approaches by an absolute 22% in 12 iterative learning steps, and on reasoning questions in HotPotQA [28] by 20%, and Python programming tasks on HumanEval [6] by as much as 11%.

我们在三类任务上开展实验：（1）决策任务，用于测试长轨迹中的序列行动选择；（2）推理任务，用于测试知识密集型单次生成的改进；（3）编程任务，用于教导智能体有效使用编译器、解释器等外部工具。在这三类任务中，我们观察到Reflexion智能体都能作出更好的决策、推理和编程。更具体地说，经过12步迭代学习，Reflexion智能体在AlfWorld [24]决策任务上相较强基线的表现绝对提高22个百分点；在HotPotQA [28]推理问题上提高20%；在HumanEval [6]的Python编程任务上，提升幅度最高达11%。
To summarize, our contributions are the following:
概括而言，我们的贡献如下：
We propose Reflexion, a new paradigm for verbal reinforcement that parameterizes a policy as an agent's memory encoding paired with a choice of LLM parameters.
我们提出Reflexion，一种新的“言语”强化范式，将智能体的记忆编码与选定的LLM参数相配合，用以参数化策略。
We explore this emergent property of self-reflection in LLMs and empirically show that self-reflection is extremely useful to learn complex tasks over a handful of trials.
我们探索LLM中涌现的自我反思特性，并以实证结果表明，自我反思对于通过少量尝试学会复杂任务极其有用。
We introduce LeetcodeHardGym, a code-generation RL gym environment consisting of 40 challenging Leetcode questions (hard-level) in 19 programming languages.
我们推出LeetcodeHardGym，一个用于代码生成的强化学习gym环境，包含40道具有挑战性的Leetcode题目（难度为“hard-level”），涵盖19种编程语言。
We show that Reflexion achieves improvements over strong baselines across several tasks, and achieves state-of-the-art results on various code generation benchmarks.
我们表明，Reflexion在多种任务上优于强基线，并在若干代码生成基准上取得最先进的结果。
2 Related work
2 相关工作
Reasoning and decision-making
推理与决策

Self-Refine [15] employs an iterative framework for self-refinement to autonomously improve generation through self-evaluation. These self-evaluation and self-improvement steps are conditioned on given task constraints, such as "How can this generation be written in a more positive way". Self-Refine is effective but is limited to single-generation reasoning tasks. Pryzant et al. [21] performs a similar semantic prompt-writing optimization, but is also limited to single-generation tasks. Paul et al. [20] fine-tune critic models to provide intermediate feedback within trajectories to improve reasoning responses. Xie et al. [27] use stochastic beam search over actions to perform a more efficient decision-making search strategy which allows the agent to use foresight advantage due to its self-evaluation component. Yoran et al. [31] and Nair et al. [16] use decider models to reason over several generations. Kim et al. [10] use a retry pattern over a fixed number of steps without an evaluation step. Goodman [9] perform a qualitative evaluation step that proposes optimizations to the previous generation. In this paper, we show that several of these concepts can be enhanced with self-reflection to build a persisting memory of self-reflective experiences which allows an agent to identify its own errors and self-suggest lessons to learn from its mistakes over time.

Self-Refine [15]采用迭代式的自我改进框架，通过自我评估自主改进生成结果。这些自我评估和自我改进步骤以给定的任务约束为条件，例如“怎样才能将这一生成结果写得更积极一些”。Self-Refine有效，但仅限于单次生成的推理任务。Pryzant等人 [21]进行了类似的语义层面提示编写优化，但同样局限于单次生成任务。Paul等人 [20]微调评判者模型，在轨迹中提供中间反馈，以改进推理回答。Xie等人 [27]对行动使用随机束搜索，实施更高效的决策搜索策略；其自我评估组件使智能体能够利用前瞻优势。Yoran等人 [31]和Nair等人 [16]使用决策者模型，对多个生成结果进行推理。Kim等人 [10]在固定步数内采用重试模式，不设评估步骤。Goodman [9]进行定性评估，对先前的生成结果提出优化建议。本文表明，其中若干概念能够通过自我反思得到增强，构建持续保存自我反思经验的记忆，使智能体能够识别自身错误，并随时间推移，自行提出可从错误中吸取的教训。

Programming
编程

Several past and recent works employ variations of test-driven development or code debugging practices. AlphaCode [14] evaluates a set of generations on hidden test cases. CodeT [5] uses self-generated unit tests that are used to score generated function implementations. Self-Debugging [7] employs a debugging component that is used to improve existing implementations given feedback from a code execution environment. CodeRL [12] sets the problem in an RL framework using an actor-critic setup to debug programs given feedback from an execution environment. AlphaCode, Self-Debugging and CodeRL are effective in fixing less-complex program bugs, but they rely upon ground truth test cases that invalidate pass@1 eligibility, and do not use self-reflection to bridge the gap between error identification and implementation improvement. CodeT does not access hidden test cases but does not implement a self-learning step to improve code writing.

过去和近期的一些工作采用了测试驱动开发或代码调试实践的不同变体。AlphaCode [14]利用隐藏测试用例评估一组生成结果。CodeT [5]使用自行生成的单元测试，对生成的函数实现评分。Self-Debugging [7]采用调试组件，根据代码执行环境提供的反馈，改进现有实现。CodeRL [12]将问题置于强化学习框架中，采用行动者—评判者结构，根据执行环境的反馈调试程序。AlphaCode、Self-Debugging与CodeRL能够有效修复复杂度较低的程序错误，但它们依赖真实测试用例，因而不具备按pass@1评估的资格；它们也不利用自我反思来弥合识别错误与改进实现之间的差距。CodeT不访问隐藏测试用例，但也没有实现用于改进代码编写的自我学习步骤。
3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection
section: 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化

text: 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化
section: 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化

text: We develop a modular formulation for Reflexion, utilizing three distinct models: an Actor, denoted as $Ma$, which generates text and actions; an Evaluator model, represented by $Me$, that scores the outputs produced by $Ma$; and a Self-Reflection model, denoted as $M{sr}$, which generates verbal reinforcement cues to assist the Actor in self-improvement. We provide a detailed description of each of these models and subsequently elucidate their collaborative functioning within the Reflexion framework.
section: 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化

text: 我们为Reflexion构建了一种模块化表述，使用三种不同的模型：行动者（Actor），记作$Ma$，生成文本和行动；评估器（Evaluator）模型，记作$Me$，对$Ma$生成的输出评分；以及自我反思（Self-Reflection）模型，记作$M{sr}$，生成言语强化线索，帮助行动者自我改进。下面先详细介绍各个模型，再阐明它们在Reflexion框架中如何协同工作。

text: Actor
行动者

The Actor is built upon a large language model (LLM) that is specifically prompted to generate the necessary text and actions conditioned on the state observations. Analogous to traditional policy-based RL setups, we sample an action or generation, $at$, from the current policy $\pi{\theta}$ at time $t$, receive an observation from the environment $ot$. We explore various Actor models, including Chain of Thought [26] and ReAct [30]. These diverse generation models allow us to explore different aspects of text and action generation within the Reflexion framework, providing valuable insights into their performance and effectiveness. In addition, we also add a memory component mem that provides additional context to this agent. This adaption was inspired by Brooks et al. [3], who suggest a policy iteration approach using in-context learning. Details on how this is populated are provided below.

行动者以大语言模型（LLM）为基础，借助专门设计的提示，根据状态观察生成所需文本和行动。类似于传统的基于策略的强化学习设置，我们在时间$t$从当前策略$\pi{\theta}$采样一个行动或生成结果$at$，并接收来自环境的观察$ot$。我们探索了不同的行动者模型，包括思维链 [26]与ReAct [30]。这些不同的生成模型使我们能够在Reflexion框架内探索文本和行动生成的不同方面，为理解它们的表现和有效性提供有价值的见解。此外，我们还加入记忆组件mem，为该智能体提供额外上下文。这一改动受到Brooks等人 [3]的启发，他们提出了利用上下文学习进行策略迭代的方法。下文将详细说明如何填充这一记忆组件。
Evaluator
评估器

The Evaluator component of the Reflexion framework plays a crucial role in assessing the quality of the generated outputs produced by the Actor. It takes as input a generated trajectory and computes a reward score that reflects its performance within the given task context. Defining effective value and reward functions that apply to semantic spaces is difficult, so we investigate several variants of the Evaluator model. For reasoning tasks, we explore reward functions based on exact match (EM) grading, ensuring that the generated output aligns closely with the expected solution. In decision-making tasks, we employ pre-defined heuristic functions that are tailored to specific evaluation criteria. Additionally, we experiment with using a different instantiation of an LLM itself as an Evaluator, generating rewards for decision-making and programming tasks. This multi-faceted approach to Evaluator design allows us to examine different strategies for scoring generated outputs, offering insights into their effectiveness and suitability across a range of tasks.

Reflexion框架中的评估器组件，对评判行动者生成输出的质量起着关键作用。它以生成的轨迹为输入，计算一个反映其在给定任务情境中表现的奖励分数。为语义空间定义有效的价值函数和奖励函数并不容易，因此我们考察了评估器模型的若干变体。在推理任务中，我们探索了基于精确匹配（EM）评分的奖励函数，以确保生成输出与预期解答紧密一致。在决策任务中，我们采用针对具体评估标准预先定义的启发式函数。此外，我们还尝试将LLM本身的另一个实例用作评估器，为决策和编程任务生成奖励。这样从多个方面设计评估器，使我们得以考察对生成输出评分的不同策略，了解它们在不同任务中的有效性与适用性。
Self-reflection
自我反思

The Self-Reflection model instantiated as an LLM, plays a crucial role in the Reflexion framework by generating verbal self-reflections to provide valuable feedback for future trials. Given a sparse reward signal, such as a binary success status (success/fail), the current trajectory, and its persistent memory mem, the self-reflection model generates nuanced and specific feedback. This feedback, which is more informative than scalar rewards, is then stored in the agent's memory (mem). For instance, in a multi-step decision-making task, when the agent receives a failure signal, it can infer that a specific action $ai$ led to subsequent incorrect actions $a{i+1}$ and $a{i+2}$. The agent can then verbally state that it should have taken a different action, $ai'$, which would have resulted in $a{i+1}'$ and $a{i+2}'$, and store this experience in its memory. In subsequent trials, the agent can leverage its past experiences to adapt its decision-making approach at time $t$ by choosing action $ai'$. This iterative process of trial, error, self-reflection, and persisting memory enables the agent to rapidly improve its decision-making ability in various environments by utilizing informative feedback signals.

自我反思模型由LLM实现，通过生成言语形式的自我反思，为未来尝试提供有价值的反馈，在Reflexion框架中发挥关键作用。给定稀疏奖励信号，例如二元成功状态（成功／失败）、当前轨迹及持续保存的记忆mem，自我反思模型会生成细致而具体的反馈。这些反馈比标量奖励包含更多信息，随后被存入智能体的记忆（mem）。例如，在多步决策任务中，当智能体收到失败信号时，它可以推断某个特定行动$ai$导致了后续错误行动$a{i+1}$与$a{i+2}$。随后，智能体可以用语言说明，自己本应采取另一个行动$ai'$，那样就会产生$a{i+1}'$与$a{i+2}'$，并将这一经验存入记忆。在后续尝试中，智能体可以利用以往经验，选择行动$ai'$，从而调整时间$t$的决策方式。这个由尝试、出错、自我反思及持续记忆构成的迭代过程，使智能体能够利用信息丰富的反馈信号，迅速提高在不同环境中的决策能力。
Memory
记忆

Core components of the Reflexion process are the notion of short-term and long-term memory. At inference time, the Actor conditions its decisions on short and long-term memory, similar to the way that humans remember fine-grain recent details while also recalling distilled important experiences from long-term memory. In the RL setup, the trajectory history serves as the short-term memory while outputs from the Self-Reflection model are stored in long-term memory. These two memory components work together to provide context that is specific but also influenced by lessons learned over several trials, which is a key advantage of Reflexion agents over other LLM action choice works.

短期记忆与长期记忆的概念，是Reflexion过程的核心组成部分。在推断时，行动者依据短期和长期记忆作出决策，就像人类既记住近期的细节，也从长期记忆中回想提炼后的重要经验一样。在强化学习设置中，轨迹历史充当短期记忆，而自我反思模型的输出则存入长期记忆。这两种记忆组件协同提供上下文：它既包含具体信息，也受到多次尝试中所学教训的影响。这是Reflexion智能体相较于其他LLM行动选择工作的一个主要优势。
The Reflexion process
Reflexion过程

Reflexion is formalized as an iterative optimization process in 1. In the first trial, the Actor produces a trajectory $\tau0$ by interacting with the environment. The Evaluator then produces a score $r0$ which is computed as $rt = Me(\tau0)$. $rt$ is only a scalar reward for trial $t$ that improves as task-specific performance increases. After the first trial, to amplify $r0$ to a feedback form that can be used for improvement by an LLM, the Self-Reflection model analyzes the set of $\{\tau0, r0\}$ to produce a summary $sr0$ which is stored in the memory mem. $srt$ is a verbal experience feedback for trial $t$. The Actor, Evaluator, and Self-Reflection models work together through trials in a loop until the Evaluator deems $\taut$ to be correct. As mentioned in 3, the memory component of Reflexion is crucial to its effectiveness. After each trial $t$, $srt$, is appended mem. In practice, we bound mem by a maximum number of stored experiences, $\Omega$ (usually set to 1-3) to adhere to max context LLM limitations.

算法1将Reflexion形式化为一个迭代优化过程。在第一次尝试中，行动者通过与环境交互生成轨迹$\tau0$。随后，评估器生成分数$r0$，其计算式为$rt = Me(\tau0)$。$rt$仅是尝试$t$的标量奖励，随具体任务表现的提升而提高。在第一次尝试之后，为将$r0$扩展为LLM可据之改进的反馈形式，自我反思模型分析集合$\{\tau0, r0\}$，生成摘要$sr0$并存入记忆mem。$srt$是尝试$t$的言语经验反馈。行动者、评估器与自我反思模型在多次尝试中循环协作，直到评估器判定$\taut$正确为止。如第3节所述，记忆组件对于Reflexion的有效性至关重要。每次尝试$t$之后，都会将$srt$附加到mem中。在实践中，我们用最多保存的经验数量$\Omega$（通常设为1-3）来限制mem，以适应LLM的最大上下文限制。
4 Experiments
4 实验

We evaluate various natural language RL setups on decision-making, reasoning, and code generation tasks. Specifically, we challenge an agent to perform search-based question answering on HotPotQA [28], multi-step tasks in common household environments in AlfWorld [24], and code writing tasks in competition-like environments with interpreters and compilers in HumanEval [6], MBPP [2], and LeetcodeHard, a new benchmark. Most notably, Reflexion improves performance over strong baselines by 22% in AlfWorld, 20% in HotPotQA, and 11% on HumanEval.

我们在决策、推理和代码生成任务上评估不同的自然语言强化学习设置。具体而言，我们要求智能体完成HotPotQA [28]中基于搜索的问答、AlfWorld [24]中普通家庭环境内的多步任务，以及HumanEval [6]、MBPP [2]和新基准LeetcodeHard中类似竞赛、配有解释器和编译器的环境里的代码编写任务。尤其值得关注的是，相较强基线，Reflexion在AlfWorld上提升22%，在HotPotQA上提升20%，在HumanEval上提升11%。
4.1 Sequential decision making: ALFWorld
4.1 序列决策：ALFWorld

AlfWorld is a suite of text-based environments that challenge an agent to solve multi-step tasks in a variety of interactive environments based on TextWorld [8]. Following Yao et al. [30], we run the agent in 134 AlfWorld environments across six different tasks, including finding hidden objects (e.g., finding a spatula in a drawer), moving objects (e.g., moving a knife to the cutting board), and manipulating objects with other objects (e.g., chilling a tomato in the fridge). We use ReAct [30] as the action generator as Yao et al. [30] has shown success in long trajectory decision-making using explicit intermediate thoughts. AlfWorld tasks naturally require a self-evaluation step as the environment can only signal if a task is complete. To achieve fully autonomous behavior, we implement two self-evaluation techniques: natural language classification using an LLM and a hand-written heuristic. The heuristic is simple: if the agent executes the same action and receives the same response for more than 3 cycles, or if the number of actions taken in the current environment exceeds 30 (inefficient planning), we self-reflect. In the baseline runs, if self-reflection is suggested, we skip the self-reflection process, reset the environment, and start a new trial. In the Reflexion runs, the agent uses self-reflection to find its mistake, update its memory, reset the environment, and start a new trial. To avoid very long prompt windows that may exceed the maximum limit, we truncate the agent's memory to the last 3 self-reflections (experiences).

AlfWorld是一套基于文本的环境，要求智能体在基于TextWorld [8]的多种交互环境中解决多步任务。遵循Yao等人 [30]的做法，我们让智能体在134个AlfWorld环境中运行，涵盖六种不同任务，包括寻找隐藏物品（如在抽屉里找铲子）、移动物品（如将刀移到砧板上），以及借助其他物品操作某物（如将番茄放入冰箱冷却）。我们使用ReAct [30]作为行动生成器，因为Yao等人 [30]已展示了借助显式中间思考进行长轨迹决策的成功。AlfWorld任务自然需要自我评估步骤，因为环境只能给出任务是否完成的信号。为了实现完全自主的行为，我们实现了两种自我评估技术：使用LLM进行自然语言分类，以及人工编写的启发式规则。该规则很简单：如果智能体执行相同行动并收到相同响应，连续超过3个循环，或者在当前环境中执行的行动数超过30（规划低效），便进行自我反思。在基线运行中，如果建议进行自我反思，我们就跳过反思过程，重置环境，开始新的尝试。在Reflexion运行中，智能体则通过自我反思找出错误、更新记忆、重置环境，再开始新的尝试。为避免提示窗口过长而超过上限，我们仅保留智能体最近3次自我反思（经验），截去更早的记忆。

To avoid syntactic errors, we provide two domain-specific few-shot trajectories to the agent. We use the same few-shot trajectory examples as Yao et al. [30] with GPT-3 for the LLM. AlfWorld tasks, ReAct few-shot prompts, and Reflexion examples are included in the appendix.
为避免语法错误，我们向智能体提供两条针对该领域的少样本轨迹。我们采用与Yao等人 [30]相同的少样本轨迹示例，并以GPT-3作为LLM。AlfWorld任务、ReAct少样本提示和Reflexion示例均列于附录。
Results
结果

ReAct + Reflexion significantly outperforms ReAct by completing 130 out of 134 tasks using the simple heuristic to detect hallucinations and inefficient planning. Further, ReAct + Reflexion learns to solve additional tasks by learning in 12 consecutive trials. In the ReAct-only approach, we see that performance increase halts between trials 6 and 7.
ReAct + Reflexion利用简单启发式规则检测幻觉和低效规划，完成了134项任务中的130项，显著优于ReAct。此外，ReAct + Reflexion通过连续12次尝试中的学习，学会解决更多任务。对于仅使用ReAct的方法，我们观察到，表现的提升在第6次与第7次尝试之间停止。
Analysis
分析

A common error in baseline failed AlfWorld trajectories is when an agent thinks that it has possession of an item but does not actually have the item. The agent proceeds to execute several actions in a long trajectory and is not able to backtrack its actions to find the mistake. Reflexion eliminates almost all of these cases by using self-reflection to distill long, failed trajectories into relevant experiences that can are used as "self-hints" in the future. There are two main cases in which long-term memory helps an agent in AlfWorld: 1) An early mistake in a long trajectory can be easily identified. The agent can suggest a new action choice or even a new long-term plan. 2) There are too many surfaces/containers to check for an item. The agent can exploit its experience memory over several trials to thoroughly search a room. In 3, the learning curve suggests that the learning process occurs over several experiences, meaning that the agent is successfully balancing cases 1 and 2 shown in the immediate spike in the improvement between the first two trials, then a steady increase over the next 11 trials to a near-perfect performance. On the other hand, 3 shows a ReAct-only agent converging at a hallucination rate of 22% with no signs of long-term recovery.

基线方法在AlfWorld失败轨迹中的一个常见错误，是智能体以为自己已持有某件物品，实际却没有。智能体接着在长轨迹中执行多个行动，却无法回溯自己的行动以找出错误。Reflexion通过自我反思，将冗长的失败轨迹提炼为相关经验，供未来用作“自我提示”，从而消除了几乎全部此类情形。在AlfWorld中，长期记忆主要在两种情况下帮助智能体：1）能够轻易识别长轨迹中较早出现的错误。智能体可以提出新的行动选择，甚至新的长期计划。2）需要检查的物体表面或容器太多，难以找到某件物品。智能体可以利用多次尝试积累的经验记忆，彻底搜索一个房间。图3中的学习曲线表明，学习过程发生在多次经验之间，意味着智能体成功地平衡了情况1与情况2：前两次尝试之间的表现立即大幅提高，此后11次尝试稳步上升，接近完美表现。另一方面，图3显示，仅使用ReAct的智能体收敛于22%的幻觉率，看不到长期恢复的迹象。

4.2 Reasoning: HotpotQA
4.2 推理：HotpotQA

HotPotQA [28] is a Wikipedia-based dataset with 113k question-and-answer pairs that challenge agents to parse content and reason over several supporting documents. To test improvement in reasoning only ability, we implement Reflexion + Chain-of-Thought (CoT) [26] for step-by-step $Q \rightarrow A$ and $Q$, $C{gt} \rightarrow A$ implementations, where $Q$ is the question, $C{gt}$ is the ground truth context from the dataset, and $A$ is the final answer. Since CoT is not a multi-step decision-making technique, we give $C{gt}$ to the agent so that we can isolate the reasoning behavior over large sections of the provided text. To test holistic question and answering ability, which requires reasoning and action choice, we implement a Reflexion + ReAct [30] agent that can retrieve relevant context using a Wikipedia API and infer answers using step-by-step explicit thinking. For CoT implementations, we use 6-shot prompting; for ReAct, we use 2-shot prompting, and for self-reflection, we use 2-shot prompting. All examples can be found in the appendix.

HotPotQA [28]是一个基于维基百科的数据集，包含113k个问答对，要求智能体解析内容，并依据若干支持文档进行推理。为仅测试推理能力的改进，我们实现了Reflexion + 思维链（CoT）[26]，分别采用逐步的$Q \rightarrow A$和$Q$、$C{gt} \rightarrow A$设置，其中$Q$是问题，$C{gt}$是数据集中的真实上下文，$A$是最终答案。由于CoT不是一种多步决策技术，我们将$C{gt}$提供给智能体，从而单独考察它针对所给大段文本的推理行为。为测试需要推理和行动选择的整体问答能力，我们实现了Reflexion + ReAct [30]智能体，借助维基百科API检索相关上下文，并通过逐步的显式思考推断答案。对于CoT实现，我们使用6样本提示；对于ReAct，使用2样本提示；对于自我反思，也使用2样本提示。全部示例均见附录。

Robustly evaluating natural language answers is a long-standing problem in NLP. Therefore, between trials, we use exact match answer grading using the environment to give a binary success signal to the agent. After each trial, the self-reflection loop is employed to amplify the binary signal, similar to the decision-making setup 4.1 in AlfWorld with a memory size of 3 experiences.
稳健评估自然语言答案，是自然语言处理领域长期存在的问题。因此，在两次尝试之间，我们利用环境进行答案精确匹配评分，为智能体提供二元成功信号。每次尝试之后，都会使用自我反思循环来扩展这一二元信号，类似于AlfWorld中第4.1节的决策设置，记忆容量为3条经验。
Results
结果

Reflexion outperforms all baseline approaches by significant margins over several learning steps. Furthermore, ReAct-only, CoT-only, and CoT (GT)-only implementations fail to probabilistically improve on any tasks, meaning that no failed tasks from the first trial from any of the baseline approaches were able to be solved in subsequent trials using a temperature of 0.7 In the Reflexion runs, we allowed the agent to gather experience and retry on failed tasks until it produced 3 consecutive failed attempts on the particular task. Naturally, the CoT (GT) achieved higher accuracy scores as it was given access to the ground truth context of the question. Still, the CoT (GT) agent is unable to correctly infer the correct answer for 39% of the questions, but Reflexion helps the agent to correct its mistakes without access to the ground truth answer to improve its accuracy by 14%.

Analysis
分析

We perform an ablation experiment to isolate the advantage of the self-reflective step for reasoning using CoT (GT) as the baseline approach 4. Recall that CoT (GT) uses Chain-of-Thought reasoning with provided ground truth context, which tests reasoning ability over long contexts. Next, we add an element of episodic memory (EPM) by including the most recent trajectory. For the Reflexion agent, we implement the standard self-reflection step as a final pass. Intuitively, we test if the agent is iteratively learning more effectively by using verbal explanation using language written in the first person. 4 shows that self-reflection improves learning by an 8% absolute boost over the episodic memory learning advantage. This result supports the argument that refinement-only approaches are not as effective as self-reflection-guided refinement approaches.

我们以CoT（GT）为基线方法开展消融实验，单独考察自我反思步骤对推理的优势，见图4。回顾前文，CoT（GT）利用给定的真实上下文进行思维链推理，测试针对长上下文的推理能力。接着，我们通过纳入最近一次轨迹，加入情景记忆（EPM）要素。对于Reflexion智能体，我们将标准自我反思步骤作为最后一轮处理。直观地说，我们测试的是：使用第一人称语言写出的言语解释，能否让智能体更有效地迭代学习。图4表明，在情景记忆所带来学习优势的基础上，自我反思又使表现绝对提高8个百分点。该结果支持这样的判断：仅做改进的方法，不如由自我反思引导改进的方法有效。
4.3 Programming
4.3 编程

We evaluate the baseline and Reflexion approaches on Python and Rust code writing on MBPP [2], HumanEval [6], and LeetcodeHardGym, our new dataset. MBPP and HumanEval measure function body generation accuracy given natural language descriptions. We use a benchmark language compiler, MultiPL-E [4], to translate subsets of HumanEval and MBPP to the Rust language. MultiPL-E is a collection of small compilers that can be used to translate Python benchmark questions to 18 other languages. We include experiments for Rust code generation to demonstrate that Reflexion implementations for code generation are language-agnostic and can be used for interpreted and compiled languages. Lastly, we introduce a new benchmark, LeetcodeHardGym, which is an interactive programming gym that contains 40 Leetcode hard-rated questions that have been released after October 8, 2022, which is the pre-training cutoff date of GPT-4 [18].

我们在MBPP [2]、HumanEval [6]以及我们的新数据集LeetcodeHardGym上，对基线方法与Reflexion方法进行Python和Rust代码编写评估。MBPP与HumanEval衡量根据自然语言描述生成函数体的准确率。我们使用基准语言编译器MultiPL-E [4]，将HumanEval与MBPP的子集转换为Rust语言。MultiPL-E是一组小型编译器，可将Python基准题目转换为另外18种语言。我们纳入Rust代码生成实验，以展示Reflexion的代码生成实现不依赖具体语言，既可用于解释型语言，也可用于编译型语言。最后，我们推出新基准LeetcodeHardGym，这是一个交互式编程gym，包含40道评级为hard的Leetcode题目；这些题目都发布于2022年10月8日之后，而该日期是GPT-4 [18]的预训练截止日期。

The task of programming presents a unique opportunity to use more grounded self-evaluation practices such as self-generated unit test suites. Thus, our Reflexion-based programming task implementation is eligible for pass@1 accuracy reporting. To generate a test suite, we use Chain-of-Thought prompting [26] to produce diverse, extensive tests with corresponding natural language descriptions. Then, we filter for syntactically valid test statements by attempting to construct a valid abstract syntax tree (AST) for each proposed test. Finally, we sample $n$ tests from the collection of generated unit tests to produce a test suite $T$, denoted as $\{t0, t1, …, tn\}$. We set $n$ to a maximum of 6 unit tests. Aside from the unit test suite component, the setup for the learning loop for a Reflexion programming agent is identical to the reasoning and decision-making agents with a max memory limit of 1 experience.

编程任务提供了独特机会，使我们能够采用更有实据的自我评估实践，例如自行生成单元测试套件。因此，我们基于Reflexion的编程任务实现，具备报告pass@1准确率的资格。为生成测试套件，我们使用思维链提示 [26]，产生多样而广泛的测试及相应的自然语言描述。接着，我们尝试为每个提出的测试构建有效的抽象语法树（AST），以筛选语法有效的测试语句。最后，从生成的单元测试集合中采样$n$个测试，形成测试套件$T$，记作$\{t0, t1, …, tn\}$。我们将$n$的最大值设为6个单元测试。除单元测试套件组件之外，Reflexion编程智能体的学习循环设置，与推理和决策智能体相同，记忆上限为1条经验。

Results
结果

Reflexion outperforms all baseline accuracies and sets new state-of-the-art standards on all benchmarks for Python and Rust except for MBPP Python 1. We further investigate the inferior performance of Reflexion on MBPP Python.
除MBPP Python以外，Reflexion在所有Python与Rust基准上都超过了全部基线准确率，并创下新的最先进水平，见表1。我们进一步研究Reflexion在MBPP Python上表现较差的原因。
Analysis
分析

We acknowledge that self-reflecting code-generation agents are bound to their ability to write diverse, comprehensive tests. Therefore, in the case in which the model generates a flaky test suite, it is possible that all tests pass on an incorrect solution and lead to a false positive label on a code completion [11]. On the other hand, if the model produces an incorrectly written test suite, it is possible for some of the tests to fail on a correct solution, leading to a self-reflection generation that is conditioned on a false negative code completion. Given the implementation of Reflexion, false negatives are preferred over false positives as the agent may be able to use self-reflection to identify the incorrect test(s) and prompt itself to keep the original code completion intact. On the other hand, if an invalid test suite returns a false positive completion (all internal test cases pass but the implementation is incorrect), the agent will prematurely report an invalid submission. In 2, various conditions are measured to analyze performance beyond pass@1 accuracy. Previously, we displayed the inferior performance of Reflexion to the baseline GPT-4 on MBPP Python. In 2, we observe a notable discrepancy between the false positive labels produced by internal test execution, P(not pass@1 generation correct | tests pass). That is, the probability that a submission will fail given that it passes all unit tests. For HumanEval and MBPP Python, the baseline pass@1 accuracies are relatively similar, 82% and 80%, respectively. However, the false positive test execution rate for MBPP Python is 16.3% while the rate for HumanEval Python is a mere 1.4%, leading to 91% overall accuracy 1.

我们承认，进行自我反思的代码生成智能体，受限于其编写多样而全面的测试的能力。因此，如果模型生成了不稳定的测试套件，便可能出现错误解答通过全部测试的情况，导致代码补全结果被标记为假阳性 [11]。另一方面，如果模型编写的测试套件有误，则可能出现正确解答未通过某些测试的情况，从而基于一个假阴性的代码补全结果生成自我反思。根据Reflexion的实现方式，假阴性优于假阳性，因为智能体可能通过自我反思识别错误测试，并提示自己保留原代码补全结果。相反，若无效测试套件返回假阳性的补全结果（所有内部测试用例均通过，但实现有误），智能体就会过早报告无效提交。表2测量了不同情形，以分析pass@1准确率之外的表现。此前，我们已展示Reflexion在MBPP Python上逊于基线GPT-4。表2中，内部测试执行产生的假阳性标记——P(not pass@1 generation correct | tests pass)——呈现明显差异，即提交通过全部单元测试时，该提交仍会失败的概率。对于HumanEval与MBPP Python，基线pass@1准确率相近，分别为82%与80%。然而，MBPP Python的测试执行假阳性率为16.3%，HumanEval Python则仅为1.4%，从而产生表1所示91%的总体准确率。

Ablation study
消融研究

We test the composite approach of Reflexion for test generation and self-reflection cooperation on a subset of the 50 hardest HumanEval Rust problems. Our Rust compiler environment provides verbose error logs and helpful debugging hints, therefore serving as a good playground for compromised approaches. First, we omit internal test generation and execution steps, which test the agent to self-reflect without guidance from current implementations. 3 shows an inferior 52% vs 60% (baseline) accuracy, which suggests that the agent is unable to determine if the current implementation is correct without unit tests. Therefore, the agent must participate in all iterations of the run without the option to return early, performing harmful edits to the implementation.

我们在HumanEval Rust中最难的50道题的一个子集上，测试Reflexion中测试生成与自我反思协作的组合方法。我们的Rust编译器环境提供详尽的错误日志与有用的调试提示，因此是检验组件删减方法的良好试验场。首先，我们省略内部测试生成和执行步骤，测试智能体在缺乏当前实现所提供指导时进行自我反思的能力。表3显示，其准确率较差，为52%，而基线为60%，这提示没有单元测试时，智能体无法判断当前实现是否正确。因此，智能体不得不参与整次运行的全部迭代，无法提前返回，进而对实现作出有害修改。

Next, we test self-reflection contribution by omitting the natural language explanation step following failed unit test suite evaluations. Intuitively, this challenges the agent to combine the tasks of error identification and implementation improvement across all failed unit tests. Interestingly, the compromised agent does not improve performance over the baseline run. We observe that the test generation and code compilation steps are able to catch syntax and logic errors, but the implementation fixes do not reflect these indications. These empirical results suggest that several recent works that propose blind trial and error debugging techniques without self-reflection are ineffective on harder tasks such as writing complex programs in Rust.

接着，我们省略单元测试套件评估失败之后的自然语言解释步骤，以测试自我反思的贡献。直观地说，这要求智能体针对全部失败的单元测试，将识别错误与改进实现两项任务结合起来。有意思的是，删去该组件后的智能体相较基线运行并没有改善表现。我们观察到，测试生成和代码编译步骤能够发现语法与逻辑错误，但对实现所作的修正未能体现这些提示。这些实证结果提示，近期若干工作提出的不使用自我反思的盲目试错调试技术，在编写复杂Rust程序等较难任务上并不奏效。
5 Limitations
5 局限

At its core, Reflexion is an optimization technique that uses natural language to do policy optimization. Policy optimization is a powerful approach to improve action choice through experience, but it may still succumb to non-optimal local minima solutions. In this study, we limit long-term memory to a sliding window with maximum capacity, but we encourage future work to extend the memory component of Reflexion with more advanced structures such as vector embedding databases or traditional SQL databases. Specific to code generation, there are many practical limitations to test-driven development in specifying accurate input-output mappings such as non-deterministic generator functions, impure functions that interact with APIs, functions that vary output according to hardware specifications, or functions that invoke parallel or concurrent behavior that may be difficult to predict.

从核心上说，Reflexion是一种利用自然语言进行策略优化的优化技术。策略优化能够通过经验有效改善行动选择，但仍可能陷入非最优的局部极小解。在本研究中，我们将长期记忆限制在具有最大容量的滑动窗口内，同时鼓励未来工作采用向量嵌入数据库或传统SQL数据库等更高级的结构，扩展Reflexion的记忆组件。具体到代码生成，测试驱动开发在准确规定输入—输出映射方面存在许多实际限制，例如非确定性的生成器函数、与API交互的非纯函数、随硬件规格改变输出的函数，以及调用难以预测的并行或并发行为的函数。
6 Broader impact
6 更广泛的影响

Large language models are increasingly used to interact with external environments (e.g. the Internet, software, robotics, etc.) and humans. Our work has the potential of reinforcing and empowering these agents toward greater automation and work efficiency, but it also amplifies the risks when these agents were put into misuse. We believe that this direction of research will need more effort in safety and ethical considerations.
大语言模型越来越多地被用于同外部环境（如互联网、软件、机器人等）及人类交互。我们的工作有潜力强化这些智能体的能力，提高自动化程度与工作效率；但当这些智能体被滥用时，它也会放大风险。我们认为，这一研究方向需要在安全与伦理考量方面作出更多努力。

On the other hand, reinforcement learning has suffered from its black-box policy and optimization setups in which interpretability and alignment have been challenging. Our proposed “verbal” reinforcement learning might address some of the issues and turn autonomous agents more interpretable and diagnosable. For example, in the case of tool-usage that may be too hard for humans to understand, self-reflections could be monitored to ensure proper intent before using the tool.
另一方面，强化学习受制于黑箱式的策略与优化设置，可解释性和对齐一直是难题。我们提出的“言语”强化学习，或许能解决其中部分问题，使自主智能体更容易解释和诊断。例如，当工具使用过于复杂、难以为人理解时，可以监控自我反思，以便在使用工具前确保意图恰当。
7 Conclusion
7 结论

In this work, we present Reflexion, an approach that leverages verbal reinforcement to teach agents to learn from past mistakes. We empirically show that Reflexion agents significantly outperform currently widely-used decision-making approaches by utilizing self-reflection. In future work, Reflexion could be used to employ more advanced techniques that have been thoroughly studied in traditional RL settings, such as value learning in natural language or off-policy exploration techniques.
本文提出Reflexion，一种利用言语强化来教导智能体从以往错误中学习的方法。我们通过实证表明，Reflexion智能体利用自我反思，显著优于目前广泛采用的决策方法。未来，Reflexion可用于采用传统强化学习中已得到深入研究的更高级技术，例如以自然语言进行价值学习，或采用离策略探索技术。
8 Reproducibility
8 可复现性
We highly advise others to use isolated execution environments when running autonomous code writing experiments as the generated code is not validated before execution.
在开展自主代码编写实验时，我们强烈建议使用隔离的执行环境，因为生成的代码在执行之前并未经过验证。

A mug is more likely to appear in drawer (1-6), desk (1-2), shelf (1-6), garbagecan (1), laundryhamper (1). I can check one by one, starting with drawer 1. $>$ go to drawer 1 The drawer 1 is closed. … $>$ open drawer 6 You open the drawer 6. The drawer 6 is open. In it, you see a keychain 2. $>$ go to desk 1 On the desk 1, you see a creditcard 3, a desklamp 1, a laptop 2, a mug 1, a pen 1, and a pencil 1. $>$ think: Now I find a mug (1). Next, I need to take it. $>$ take mug 1 from desk 1 You pick up the mug 1 from the desk 1. $>$ think: Now I take a mug (1). Next, I need to find a desklamp. B.1 WebShop Limitation
B.1 在WebShop上的局限

In 5, we briefly state that Reflexion struggles to overcome local minima choices that require extremely creative behavior to escape. We observe this shortcoming in an experiment on WebShop [29]. WebShop is a web-based problem-solving benchmark that tests agents to navigate an e-commerce website to locate and purchase products given requests from clients. We test a two-shot ReAct + Reflexion agent in 100 environments. However, after only four trials, we terminate the runs as the agent does not show signs of improvement 6. Further, the agent does not generate helpful, intuitive self-reflections after failed attempts. We conclude that Reflexion is unable to solve tasks that require a significant amount of diversity and exploration. In AlfWorld, the agent is able to adequately explore new environments because the permissible actions can be seen in the observations. In HotPotQA, the agent faces a similar WebShop search query task but is more successful as the search space for Wikipedia articles is more diverse and requires less precise search queries. A common problem for e-commerce search engines is properly handling ambiguity in natural language search interpretations. Thus, WebShop presents a task that requires very diverse and unique behavior from a Reflexion agent.

在第5节中，我们简要指出，Reflexion难以克服需要极富创造性的行为才能摆脱的局部极小选择。我们在WebShop [29]实验中观察到了这一缺点。WebShop是一个基于网络的问题求解基准，测试智能体能否根据客户要求，浏览电子商务网站，找到并购买产品。我们在100个环境中测试了一个采用2样本提示的ReAct + Reflexion智能体。然而，仅经过四次尝试，我们便终止运行，因为智能体未显示出改进迹象，见图6。此外，智能体在尝试失败之后，也没有生成有用、直观的自我反思。我们据此得出结论，Reflexion无法解决需要大量多样性与探索的任务。在AlfWorld中，智能体能够充分探索新环境，因为观察中可以看到允许的行动。在HotPotQA中，智能体面对的是类似WebShop的搜索查询任务，却表现得更成功，因为维基百科文章的搜索空间更多样，所需查询的精确度也较低。电子商务搜索引擎的一个常见问题，是妥善处理自然语言搜索解释中的歧义。因此，WebShop提出了一项要求Reflexion智能体表现出高度多样且独特行为的任务。

ShakesVR: Redefining narrative strategies for linear storytelling in a fully immersive environment
ShakesVR：在全沉浸环境中重新界定线性故事的叙事策略
Hannes Rall Nanyang Technological University Singapore 81 Nanyang Drive, 637458 Singapore rall@ntu.edu.sg

The author posits that the author-driven approach of storytelling, resulting in a linear narrative, remains a valid approach for VR. Therefore, the paper investigates the question how a traditional storyline can be told in VR, while simultaneously addressing the specific issues that arise from the audience becoming part of the story. For instance, how might the actions of the viewer (who in traditional film would have passively consumed the story) affect the way in which the story is being experienced? In a fully immersive environment, the user can freely choose where to look and this can affect the experience of the story. How can we avoid that he/she misses essential parts of a linear storyline? Our research project therefore investigated how VR can accommodate the needs of traditional narrative forms. In this essay the author will demonstrate how the integration of interactive elements and audio-visual storytelling strategies can actually support the understanding of a linear narrative in a fully immersive environment.

本文认为，在虚拟现实中，由作者推进故事、形成线性叙事，依然是一条可行的路。因此，本文考察怎样在虚拟现实里讲一条传统故事线，同时处理观众成为故事一部分后出现的具体问题。例如，相较于传统电影中被动接受故事的观众，虚拟现实观众的行动会怎样改变他体验故事的方式？在全沉浸环境里，用户可以自由选择看哪里，这会影响故事体验。如何避免用户错过线性故事的重要部分？我们的研究项目因此考察虚拟现实怎样满足传统叙事形式的需要。本文将说明，在全沉浸环境中，把交互要素和视听叙事策略结合起来，怎样帮助用户理解线性叙事。
Shakespeare. Virtual cultural heritage. Digital animation. VR. Immersive environment.
莎士比亚。虚拟文化遗产。数字动画。虚拟现实。沉浸环境。
1. INTRODUCTION
1 引言

Over the last three years (2017–2020) the interdisciplinary research project From Print to Digital: Re-Defining Narrativity for Interactive Digital Media, was funded by the Ministry of Education in Singapore (Tier 2 grant). It explored a Shakespeare adaptation for storytelling in immersive environments (VR). This investigation was carried out in close collaboration with the Shakespeare Institute in Stratford-upon-Avon, namely its Director, Prof. Michael Dobson.
过去三年（2017—2020），跨学科研究项目“从印刷到数字：重新界定交互数字媒介的叙事性”获得新加坡教育部第二类研究资助。项目探索将莎士比亚剧作改编为沉浸环境（虚拟现实）中的故事。这项研究与埃文河畔斯特拉特福的莎士比亚研究所密切合作，合作者尤以所长迈克尔·多布森教授为主。

Our research method built from initial scholarly research towards the completion of a practical component that served as an experiment to test our theories. Three major Shakespeare plays (Macbeth, The Tempest; A Midsummer Night’s Dream) were adapted as abridged versions for animated VR, completed in January 2020. Three different worlds were created that corresponded with the respective plays. The user may discover these worlds through a narrative that connects plays and worlds. In this paper, it is proposed that the author-driven approach of storytelling, resulting in a linear narrative, remains a valid approach for VR. Therefore, this paper investigates the question how a traditional storyline can be told in VR, while simultaneously addressing the specific issues that arise from the audience becoming part of the story. For instance, how might the actions of the viewer (who in traditional film would have passively consumed the story) affect the way in which the story is being experienced? In a fully immersive environment, the user can freely choose where to look and this can affect the experience of the story.

研究方法从最初的学术研究出发，最终完成一个实践项目，作为检验理论的实验。《麦克白》《暴风雨》和《仲夏夜之梦》三部莎士比亚重要剧作，都以节编版改编为虚拟现实动画，2020年1月完成。三个不同的世界分别对应三部剧，用户能顺着把作品和世界连在一起的故事发现它们。本文认为，由作者推进故事而形成的线性叙事，在虚拟现实中依然可行。本文由此考察怎样在虚拟现实中讲述传统故事，同时处理观众成为故事的一部分之后产生的具体问题。例如，传统电影观众往往被动接受故事，那么，当观众可以行动时，会怎样体验这个故事？在全沉浸环境中，用户可以自由选择朝哪里看，这会影响故事的体验。

However, the question arises of how can we avoid the audience missing essential parts of a linear storyline. Our research project therefore investigated how VR can accommodate the needs of traditional narrative forms. In this essay the author will demonstrate how the integration of interactive elements and audio-visual storytelling strategies can actually support the understanding of a linear narrative in a fully immersive environment.
随之而来的问题是，怎样让观众尽量不漏过线性故事的关键部分？我们的研究项目因此考察虚拟现实怎样容纳传统叙事形式的需要。本文将说明，在全沉浸环境中，如何通过结合交互要素和视听叙事策略，帮助用户理解一个线性故事。

To address the first question, one might ask why the author aimed to use traditional (linear) storytelling within a fully immersive world. Would this environment not naturally lead itself more towards a non-linear approach that would allow the user to drive the narrative? This would obviously have the advantage that the user is in full control of the story and his attention would be naturally directed where it is supposed to be (by and large, whereas limitations in practice might apply). In other words: why not simply adapt a more 'gamified' approach instead of 'sticking' with seemingly outdated narrative concepts as established in traditional filmmaking? Yet, there are strong arguments for an author-driven approach that still favours a traditional sequence of events. Moreover, the paper will also address the question how cultural heritage such as Shakespeare’s classical literary canon can be adapted adequately for virtual media. It will unpack the connection between scholarly analysis of source material, the writing of the abridged adaptations, and the development of the corresponding visual adaptation strategies.

要回答第一个问题，或许得先问，为什么作者想在全沉浸的世界里使用传统的线性叙事？这种环境不是自然而然更适合非线性的做法，让用户推动叙事吗？这样显然有个好处，故事全由用户掌控，用户的注意力也自然会去到该去的地方（大体如此，实际中仍会有限制）。换句话说，为什么不干脆采用更游戏化的做法，还要“固守”传统电影制作中看起来已经过时的叙事观念？不过，按传统顺序安排事件、由作者推动故事，有充分的理由。本文还要探讨，如何把莎士比亚的经典文学等文化遗产妥善改编到虚拟媒介，具体解释原作的学术分析、节编本的写作、相应视觉改编策略的开发之间的联系。

text: 3. STRATEGIES FOR DIRECTING ATTENTION IN VR TOWARDS THE NARRATIVE
section: 3 虚拟现实中将注意力引向叙事的策略

text: 3 虚拟现实中将注意力引向叙事的策略
section: 3 虚拟现实中将注意力引向叙事的策略

text: For a start, it will be useful to reintroduce the major practical problem for delivering a linear narrative in VR. If the user is free to look wherever he/she chooses at any given point in time, how can it be avoided that they miss any crucial part of storytelling? To use an example: If story-relevant action takes place in location A of the VR-world, but the users choose to look at point B instead, they might not be able to understand the story anymore. ShakesVR was facing precisely this problem, because an interconnected story is told that unfolds largely on a continuous timeline, with only few instances where interactivity allows the user to specifically trigger events.
section: 3 虚拟现实中将注意力引向叙事的策略

text: 先回到在虚拟现实中呈现线性叙事时最主要的实践问题。如果用户在任一时刻都能想往哪里看就往哪里看，怎样避免他们错过讲故事的任何关键部分？例如，关乎故事的动作发生在虚拟世界的A处，用户却盯着B处，之后可能就无法理解故事。ShakesVR面临的正是这个问题。它讲的是一个相互连贯的故事，基本沿着一条连续的时间线展开，只有很少的情况允许用户通过互动专门触发事件。
section: 3 虚拟现实中将注意力引向叙事的策略

text: 3.1 Solutions through multi-modal story-delivery
3.1 通过多模态呈现故事

The solution our team chose to opt was to address this challenge by offering the story through a multi-modal approach. But what does that mean in practice? Simply put, it means that it is possible to follow and understand the story through multiple mediations and locations. If an event is represented through audio and video, there is a high likeliness that the user can at least here it, if not see it. A concrete example from our project can demonstrate this aptly. In our version of Macbeth, the original story is transposed to the setting of a 19th century British naval vessel. King Duncan has become Captain Duncan, Macbeth his first officer, Macduff is another officer (third in command). A central story point is that the MacDuff is washed overboard by a gigantic wave.

我们的团队选择以多模态方式提供故事来处理这个挑战。实际意味着什么？简而言之，用户可通过不同媒介途径、在不同地点跟上并理解故事。如果一个事件同时借声音与画面表现，用户即使没看见，也很可能至少听得到。项目里的一个例子正能说明这一点。在我们改编的《麦克白》中，原故事被移到了19世纪的英国海军舰船上。邓肯国王成为邓肯舰长，麦克白是大副，麦克德夫是另一位军官，指挥顺位排第三。故事的一个关键情节，是麦克德夫被巨浪打落船外。
Figure 1: The different locations of the ship where the story of Macbeth unfolds. Visual development from ShakesVR, Hannes Rall. Figure labels: CAPTAIN’S QUARTERS; BELOW DECK.
图1 《麦克白》的故事在船上的不同地点展开。《ShakesVR》视觉开发图，汉内斯·拉尔绘制。 图中可辨手写标签：舰长舱房；甲板下舱室。

At the Annual Conference of the Society for Animation Studies in Lisbon 2019, ShakesVR was tested by a total of 27 participants of the conference who were allowed to spend as much time as they needed to experience the story in full. In the case of the aforementioned story-point, all users were able to 'get it'. Even if they did not see the event, they heard the sound of the wave washing Macduff overboard and his subsequent scream. Subsequently the VR world changed entirely to a beach where all the users saw a shipwrecked Macduff lying. The combination of video and audio with multi-location-based information made it virtually impossible for the audience to miss out on this crucial story point.
在2019年里斯本的动画研究学会年会上，会议共有27名参与者测试了 ShakesVR。他们可以花需要的时间体验完整故事。每个人都理解了刚才讲的情节。即使没亲眼看见，他们也听到了巨浪将麦克德夫打下船的声音，和他接下来的尖叫。随后虚拟世界完全切换到一片海滩，所有人都看到遇难的麦克德夫躺在那里。结合视听和基于不同地点的信息，观众几乎不可能漏掉这个关键情节。

Another strategy to enable better story-communication in a fully immersive environment is to offer the narrative content simultaneously in multiple locations. When in our story Captain Duncan is murdered in his cabin by the mutineer Macbeth, the user does not have to be there to learn of the gruesome deed. Even if he is still below deck, he will hear the (muffled) sound of the murder, and see blood dripping from the ceiling. This provides two different locations, and two different ways to audio-visually experience the same story. But what will happen, if the user is actually on the upper deck, but does not choose not to walk into the cabin where the murder takes place?
另一种在全沉浸环境中更好地传达故事的策略，是在多个地方同时提供同一叙事内容。在我们的故事里，邓肯舰长在舱房中遭叛变的麦克白杀害。用户不必在场，也能知道这件残酷的事。即使他还在甲板下，也能听见（闷住的）谋杀声，看到血从顶上滴下。这样就有两个不同的位置、两种以视听体验同一件事的方式。不过，用户若在上层甲板却没有走入发生谋杀的舱房，会怎样呢？
3.2 Interactive elements to direct attention
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: Paradoxical as it may seem, interactivity offers the solution here to help the understanding of the linear storytelling. By defining a localised threshold (the entrance to the cabin), the murder itself will only take place if the user actually enters the captain’s cabin.
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: 这听起来或许自相矛盾，交互正好能解决这个问题，帮助用户理解线性故事。可以指定一个局部的阈限，也就是舱房入口，只有用户真的走进舰长舱房，谋杀本身才会发生。
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: To achieve a satisfactory delivery of the narrative as a whole, the coding must accommodate all the above-mentioned solutions accordingly:
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: 要把故事作为整体妥善呈现，代码必须兼顾上述方案：
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: - In case the user remains under the deck, the murder must unfold on a fixed timeline, and must be experienceable in any location below deck (which is not really a problem, as this is one big open space).
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: - 如果用户留在甲板下，谋杀必须沿固定时间线发生，且在甲板下的任一处都能体验到。这其实不难，因为下面是同一片开放空间。
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: - If the user decides to move upstairs, the coding must implement the threshold-solution to make sure the murder only unfolds when the user enters into the cabin.
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: - 如果用户决定上楼，代码必须实现阈限方案，保证只在用户进入舱房时才发生谋杀。
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: By combining all of these methods, our tests in Lisbon 2019 attested to a successful delivery of the narrative content even in (primarily) linear story mode. As such it can provide the narrative thread that connects the three fundamentally different worlds that were created to represent the three different plays: Macbeth, The Tempest and A Midsummer Night’s Dream. After the previous examination of the underlying storytelling mechanics, the following investigation will probe into the connection with the source-material: the original Shakespeare-texts. This will address the initial question of how cultural heritage such as Shakespeare’s classical literary canon can be adapted adequately for virtual media.
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: 2019年里斯本的测试表明，综合这些方法，即使主要采用线性讲述，叙事内容仍能成功传达。这就可以让一条叙事线索联结三个根本不同的世界，分别代表《麦克白》《暴风雨》和《仲夏夜之梦》三部剧。此前考察了故事讲述背后的机制，下面将探究它们与源材料，也就是莎士比亚剧作原文的联系。这会回答最初的问题，怎样把莎士比亚经典作品等文化遗产妥善改编到虚拟媒介。
section: 3.2 用交互要素引导注意力

text: 4. THREE WORLDS FOR VR: MASHING UP THREE SHAKESPEARE-PLAYS
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: Preceding the actual production of the VR experience, the research team benefitted from the input of one of its major collaborators: Prof. Michael Dobson, the Director of the Shakespeare Institute in Stratford-upon-Avon (Shakespeare’s birth and death place). A 2-hour interview with Prof. Dobson in Stratford, December 2016, provided the actual starting point for the concept of the VR-adaptation. As one of the world’s leading Shakespeare scholars Dobson was able to offer advice and encouragement towards our approach to 'mash-up' three major Shakespeare-plays in a fully immersive environment
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 虚拟现实体验实际开始制作前，研究团队得到了主要合作者之一迈克尔·多布森教授的意见。他是埃文河畔斯特拉特福莎士比亚研究所所长，莎士比亚就是在那里出生并去世的。2016年12月，在斯特拉特福与多布森教授进行了一次两小时的访谈，由此开始形成虚拟现实改编的构想。作为世界上一流的莎士比亚学者，多布森能为我们提供意见，并鼓励我们在全沉浸环境中混编三部莎士比亚主要剧作。
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: Figure 2: The beach setting for The Tempest. Visual development from ShakesVR, Hannes Rall.
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 图2 《暴风雨》的海滩场景。《ShakesVR》视觉开发图，汉内斯·拉尔绘制。
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: The plays were selected according to the advice of Prof. Dobson (2016) based on their capacity for VR and their potential for worldbuilding. All three of the chosen plays include supernatural elements in their storytelling, a quality that distinguishes them for an adaptation in animated VR. Animation has particularly strong capabilities for the depiction of the supernatural. Digital-Shakespeare expert Dr. Erin Sullivan (2016) and renowned animation scholar John Canemaker (2017) similarly attest to the supernatural elements in specific Shakespeare plays, as strong candidates for portrayal through animation in general, especially VR.
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 我们依据多布森教授（2016）的建议选择剧作，考虑各剧是否适合虚拟现实，以及它们在构造世界上的潜力。三部入选剧作的故事都含有超自然因素，这尤其适合改编成虚拟现实动画。动画在描绘超自然方面能力很强。数字莎士比亚研究者艾琳·沙利文（2016）和著名动画研究者约翰·凯恩梅克（2017）也认为，莎士比亚某些作品里的超自然要素很适合用动画表现，尤其适合虚拟现实。
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: Each play also offers rich opportunities for creating fully immersive environments in VR. Besides the naval setting for Macbeth, which was already introduced, two more VR worlds were created for the two other plays. A sunny island that resembles a late 60s Southern California beach-setting is provided for The Tempest. Also, a magical Chinese forest was created for A Midsummer Night’s Dream, which quotes different periods of Chinese art history to achieve a quality of timelessness (Figures 2–3).
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 每部剧都给虚拟现实中的全沉浸环境创造提供了许多机会。除了前面谈到的《麦克白》海军背景，我们还给另外两剧分别制作了虚拟世界。《暴风雨》设在一座阳光明媚的小岛，像20世纪60年代末南加利福尼亚的海滩。《仲夏夜之梦》则置于一片神奇的中国森林，借用中国艺术史上不同时代的元素，获得一种不属于特定时代的感觉（图2—3）。
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: Figure 3: The magic forest for A Midsummer Night’s Dream. Visual development from ShakesVR, Hannes Rall.
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 图3 《仲夏夜之梦》的魔法森林。《ShakesVR》视觉开发图，汉内斯·拉尔绘制。
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: The motivation for such complexity and diversity in the worldbuilding was chosen very deliberately. In doing so our team intend to represent the universality of Shakespeare beyond temporal and cultural borders. Moreover, the 'mash-up' of the chosen stories also allows an overview of the classical canon. In a nutshell, historical plays, comedies and tragedies are all represented and connected through our approach. Mixing story-elements of all three categories provides a microcosmic insight into Shakespeare’s narrative macrocosm, where dramatic and the comedic co-exist, often in the same play. In the final section, the consequences for implementing these ideas through the storytelling approaches will be discussed.
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 构建如此复杂多样的世界，是有意为之。团队希望据此表现莎士比亚超越时间和文化边界的普遍性。另外，混编所选故事，也让人一览经典作品的面貌。简言之，这一方法同时呈现历史剧、喜剧和悲剧，并将它们连在一起。将三类剧作的故事因素混合，便能从小范围了解莎士比亚的整个叙事世界。在那里，戏剧性和喜剧性共存，往往共处于同一部戏剧里。最后一节将讨论，用我们的叙事办法实现这些想法会带来什么结果。
section: 4 三个虚拟现实世界：混编三部莎士比亚剧作

text: 5. SUMMARY: WORLD-DISCOVERY AND LINEAR STORYTELLING RECONCILED
section: 5 总结：协调世界探索和线性叙事

text: 5 总结：协调世界探索和线性叙事
section: 5 总结：协调世界探索和线性叙事

text: As explained previously, the representation of the diversity and richness of Shakespeare’s canon through three very different worlds was considered important for this project. At the same time, linear narrative brings these worlds together and gives an idea of the multiplicity of tonal approaches (historic, comedic, tragic). The narrative adaptation-concept for ShakesVR therefore provides the possibility for the users to fully discover the richness of all three worlds, but also enables them to understand the story at all times.
section: 5 总结：协调世界探索和线性叙事

text: 如上所述，借三个差别很大的世界展现莎士比亚经典作品的丰富性和多样性，对这个项目很重要。与此同时，线性叙事把这些世界结合到一起，让人领会不同的基调，包括历史剧、喜剧与悲剧的基调。因此，《ShakesVR》的叙事改编构想既让用户充分发现三个世界的丰富之处，也使他们始终能理解故事。
section: 5 总结：协调世界探索和线性叙事

text: To resolve this seeming dichotomy, the research team developed a toolset that sought to make this possible. As has been demonstrated, this was mainly achieved through a multi-modal and multi-local approach that communicates story independently from the virtual location of the user. Looking forward, the research term intends to apply further perception-studies that will help to refine the initial elements of the toolset and work towards further sophistication for linear and non-linear VR-narratives. In doing the aim of this project is to make a relevant contribution towards the existing body of scholarship that engages with storytelling in VR.
section: 5 总结：协调世界探索和线性叙事

text: 为了化解这组看似矛盾的要求，团队开发了一套工具，让两者有可能共存。如上所示，主要靠采用多模态、多地点的方法，让故事的传达不取决于用户在虚拟世界的哪个位置。接下来，团队打算做进一步的感知研究，以改进这套工具的初始部分，继续完善线性和非线性的虚拟现实叙事。项目希望由此对现有虚拟现实叙事研究有所贡献。

Abstract
摘要

Introduction: Remote teaching often feels unnatural and restricted compared to on-site lectures, as traditional teaching aids are reduced to a 2D interface. The increasing adoption of VR expands online teaching platforms by offering new possibilities for educational content and enables teachers to teach more intuitively. While the potential of virtual reality (VR) for learners is well-investigated in the academic literature, VR tools for educators have hardly been explored. In this paper, we introduce the tool VRTeaching, a platform designed for presenters to enable immersive lectures using VR glasses and integrated tools such as an interactive whiteboard that can display slides, built-in chat integration to enable communication, and interactivity features such as polling tools or audience questions.

引言：相较于现场授课，远程教学往往显得不自然、受限制，因为传统教具被压缩到了二维界面中。VR的日益普及为教学内容带来新的可能，扩展了在线教学平台，使教师能够更直观地教学。学术文献已充分研究虚拟现实（VR）对学习者的潜力，而面向教育工作者的VR工具却很少受到探索。本文介绍VRTeaching：一个为演讲者设计的平台，使用VR眼镜和集成工具开展沉浸式授课。这些工具包括能够显示幻灯片的交互白板、支持交流的内置聊天整合，以及投票工具和观众提问等互动功能。

Methods: The presented study includes an expert evaluation assessing the usability and the potential of the teaching and learning platform and an investigation of the mental demand and psychophysiological responses on teachers and students giving presentations depending on the teaching environment.
方法：本研究包括一次专家评估，用于评价这一教学平台的可用性与潜力；同时考察教师和作报告的学生在不同教学环境下的心理需求及心理生理反应。
Results: The results indicate a significantly higher mental demand for the VR environment than the online environment, with no significant effects on the psychophysiological measures.
结果：结果表明，VR环境中的心理需求显著高于在线环境，而心理生理指标未受到显著影响。

Discussion: Despite the increased perceived mental demand, participants recognized the VR lecture room as having strong potential for enhancing teaching and learning experiences. These findings highlight the potential of VR-based platforms for remote education while underlining the importance of considering cognitive load aspects in their design.
讨论：尽管感知到的心理需求有所增加，参与者仍认为VR讲堂在改善教与学体验方面有很大潜力。这些发现凸显了VR平台用于远程教育的潜力，也强调了在其设计中考虑认知负荷的重要性。
KEYWORDS: virtual reality, teaching, twitch, livestreaming, instructional experience
